title: Completed pullback is left adjoint to direct image
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites small in the universe of [def-weil-size-convention], let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $I\subset A$ be an ideal. Write $D(\mathcal C,A)$ for the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant sheaf $\underline A$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on $\mathcal C$, and similarly for $\mathcal D$. Let $D_{\mathrm{comp}}(\mathcal C,A)$ be its full subcategory of derived $I$-complete complexes: for every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$ and every local section $a\in (I\underline A)(U)$, the derived sheaf Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] from $\underline A|_U[1/a]$ to $K|_U$ is zero. Here $\underline A|_U[1/a]$ is the sheafification of sectionwise localization, and derived sheaf Hom means the right derived functor of sheaf Hom.

Derived completion $C_{\mathcal C}:D(\mathcal C,A)\to D_{\mathrm{comp}}(\mathcal C,A)$ is left adjoint to the full inclusion; its underlying object is canonically
$$C_{\mathcal C}K=R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(K\otimes_A^L\underline{A/I^n}).$$
Here $\otimes^L$ is the left derived functor of the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and $R\varprojlim$ is computed by resolving a strict inverse sequence by a K-injective sequence complex (a complex such that every map to it from an acyclic sequence complex is null-homotopic) and then taking its inverse limit. The completion map is the unit of this adjunction.

Let $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi, meaning an adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ with finite-limit-preserving inverse image. Use the canonical identification $u^{-1}\underline A=\underline A$ and the resulting exact inverse image of $A$-module sheaves. Let $Lu^*$ be this inverse image on derived categories and let $Ru_*$ be the K-injective total right derived direct image [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Then $Ru_*$ preserves derived $I$-complete complexes and
$$L u^*_{\mathrm{comp}}:=C_{\mathcal D}\circ Lu^*|_{D_{\mathrm{comp}}(\mathcal C,A)}\ \dashv\ Ru_*|_{D_{\mathrm{comp}}(\mathcal D,A)}.$$
This is the adjunction induced by the ordinary derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction and the completion adjunction; in particular its units and counits are fixed by those two hom-set bijections.

proof.text: Choose the inverse-image datum from [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Build the induced geometric module direct image using [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-induced-modules]. Restrict the mate equivalence to linear morphisms using the operation diagrams of [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-module-transport] and [lem-weil-pbc-supplied-ringed-topos-kflat-pullback], then compose with scalar-extension adjunction as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction]. The explicit insertion formula proves the required underlying Hom normalization.

The inverse image preserves finite limits by the underlying-sheaf reflection argument in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback]. ConstantMap is an isomorphism, so its restriction of scalars is an equivalence by Mathlib pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence on the identity site. The scalar-extension adjunction makes extension an equivalence too. Thus pull preserves finite limits and, as a left adjoint, finite colimits. Apply [lem-sp-exact-pullback-derived-adjunction] to obtain the universal total right derived image and the normalized ordinary derived adjunction.

Choose a finite generating family of I, including the empty one for I=0. Use koszul_quotient_reflector from [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] on each site. Its unit-precomposition bijection defines an adjunction by Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. This proves the two normalized quotient-tower completion reflectors.

Apply [lem-sp-constant-direct-image-preserves-complete] to the ordinary module adjunction and universal derived direct image. The proof uses global scalar Roos endomorphisms and slice conservativity; transported ideal scalars remain in the quotient kernel by naturality, so no rigidity theorem about constant sections is needed.

Compose the target completion-reflector Hom equivalence, the ordinary derived Hom equivalence, and the inverse fully faithful Hom equivalence of the source full subcategory. Verify naturality on each side and apply Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. The defining equation is exactly the specified last Hom normalization; this fixes the unit, counit and triangle identities.
